name: FCX vs NEM Pair Trade: Ratio Z-Score & Entry Episode Paths
description: Analyzes the FCX/NEM price ratio using a 252-day rolling z-score to identify extreme dislocations (z < -2.0 for Long FCX entries). Shows: (1) z-score chart with entry signals marked, (2) event markers for each Long FCX entry with z-score, ratio, and 5d/20d/63d forward returns, (3) 63-day cumulative return path for each individual entry episode — each episode as its own line indexed to 0 at entry for direct comparison.
source:
# =============================================================================
# FCX vs NEM PAIR TRADE: RATIO Z-SCORE & MEAN-REVERSION SIGNALS
# =============================================================================
# Question: When does FCX get dislocated vs NEM, and does the ratio mean-revert?
#
# Methodology:
#   - Price ratio: FCX close / NEM close
#   - 252-day rolling z-score of the ratio
#   - Extreme signal: z < -2.0 (tighter threshold — only deep dislocations)
#   - Entry: FIRST bar z crosses below -2.0 (crossunder pulse, not persistent)
#   - Forward returns on the ratio at 5d, 20d, 63d horizons
#   - Episode path: 63-bar return path per entry, indexed to 0 at entry
#
# Assets: assets=[] — both loaded via reference_stocks (no primary asset needed)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
fcx = reference_stocks(ticker='FCX')()
nem = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()

fcx_close = fcx.c
nem_close = nem.c

# --- Price Ratio ---
ratio = fcx_close / nem_close

# --- 252-Day Rolling Z-Score of the Ratio ---
ratio_mean = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)
ratio_std  = stddev(period=252)(ratio)

# Guard: only compute z-score when std is valid and non-zero (S02)
ratio_zscore = where(is_valid(ratio_std) and ratio_std > 0, (ratio - ratio_mean) / ratio_std)

# Safe z-score for display (0.0 when insufficient history)
z = ratio_zscore if is_valid(ratio_zscore) else 0.0

# --- Extreme Signal Detection ---
# Long FCX signal: z < -2.0 (FCX cheap relative to NEM — tighter threshold)
is_long_fcx_extreme  = is_valid(ratio_zscore) and ratio_zscore < -2.0
# Short FCX signal: z > +1.5 (FCX expensive relative to NEM)
is_short_fcx_extreme = is_valid(ratio_zscore) and ratio_zscore > 1.5
# Either extreme
is_extreme = is_long_fcx_extreme or is_short_fcx_extreme

# --- Long FCX Entry Signal: FIRST bar z crosses below -2.0 (pulse, not persistent) ---
# crossunder fires exactly once per dislocation episode — the entry bar
is_long_entry = crossunder()(ratio_zscore, -2.0)

# --- Mean-Reversion Event: z crosses back through zero after being extreme ---
was_extreme = is_extreme >> 1

z_cross_up   = crossover(ratio_zscore, 0.0)
z_cross_down = crossunder()(ratio_zscore, 0.0)
z_cross_zero = z_cross_up or z_cross_down

bars_since_extreme = coalesce(barssince()(is_extreme), 999)
is_reversion = z_cross_zero and bars_since_extreme <= 63

# --- Forward Returns on the Ratio ---
fwd_5d  = forward_returns(period=5)(ratio)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(ratio)
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(ratio)

# Entry-bar forward returns (only on the crossunder bar)
entry_fwd_5d  = where(is_long_entry, fwd_5d)
entry_fwd_20d = where(is_long_entry, fwd_20d)
entry_fwd_63d = where(is_long_entry, fwd_63d)

# Entry z-score and ratio (for event marker display)
entry_zscore = where(is_long_entry, ratio_zscore)
entry_ratio  = where(is_long_entry, ratio)

# --- Episode Path Variables ---
# For each entry, track the 63-bar return path indexed to 0 at entry
# barssince gives bars elapsed since last entry (0 on entry bar, 1 next bar, etc.)
bars_since_entry = coalesce(barssince()(is_long_entry), 999)

# Ratio at entry (carried forward via valuewhen)
ratio_at_entry = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(is_long_entry, ratio)

# Running return since entry: (current ratio / ratio at entry) - 1
# Only show for the 63 bars following each entry
episode_return = where(
    is_valid(ratio_at_entry) and ratio_at_entry > 0 and bars_since_entry <= 63,
    (ratio / ratio_at_entry) - 1.0
)

# Episode label: running count of entries (1, 2, 3, ...) carried forward
# Each entry increments the counter; between entries the value stays constant
# split_by_label=True creates one line per unique integer label = one line per episode
entry_count_float = 1.0 if is_long_entry else 0.0
episode_label = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(entry_count_float)

# Short FCX signal forward returns (z > +1.5 → expect ratio to fall → negate for P&L)
short_fwd_5d  = where(is_short_fcx_extreme, -fwd_5d)
short_fwd_20d = where(is_short_fcx_extreme, -fwd_20d)
short_fwd_63d = where(is_short_fcx_extreme, -fwd_63d)

# --- Timestamps for reporters ---
ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- CHART 1: Z-Score with Entry Signals Marked (CONTEXT + SIGNAL) ---
# Core signal: how stretched is the ratio, and where are the -2.0σ entry bars?
xy_lines(
    title='FCX/NEM Z-Score: Long FCX Entries at z < -2.0',
    category='FCX/NEM Pair Trade',
    order=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score (252d)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Long FCX Entry', color=Color.Cyan, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=1.5, to=4.0, color=Color.Red, label='Short FCX Zone', opacity=0.08),
        PlotBand(from=-4.0, to=-2.0, color=Color.Green, label='Long FCX Zone', opacity=0.08)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0,  title='Mean',  color=Color.Gray,  dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.5,  title='+1.5σ', color=Color.Red,   dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, title='-2.0σ', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_axis_label='Standard Deviations from 252d Mean',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(z, where(is_long_entry, z)))

# --- EVENT MARKERS: Long FCX Entries ---
# Each marker = a new Long FCX entry episode (z crosses below -2.0)
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Long FCX Entry',
        icon=Icon.ArrowDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Z-Score at Entry',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='FCX/NEM Ratio',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=3,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Fwd Return 5d',
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Fwd Return 20d',
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Fwd Return 63d',
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                table_is_filter=True,
                table_visible=False
            )
        ]
    )
)(
    entry_zscore,
    entry_ratio,
    entry_fwd_5d,
    entry_fwd_20d,
    entry_fwd_63d,
    is_long_entry
)

# --- CHART 3: Episode Return Paths — 63-Day Window Per Entry (PUNCHLINE) ---
# Each Long FCX entry episode as its own line, indexed to 0% at entry
# X-axis = bars since entry (0–63), Y-axis = cumulative return on ratio from entry
# split_by_label creates one line per unique episode_label value
xy_lines(
    title='How Does FCX/NEM Ratio Evolve After Each Long FCX Entry? (63-Day Window)',
    category='FCX/NEM Pair Trade',
    order=3,
    split_by_label=True,
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return on Ratio Since Entry',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label='Bars Since Entry',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.IntegerFormat,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Entry Level', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=bars_since_entry, y_values=episode_return, label=episode_label)

# --- EVENT MARKERS: Mean-Reversion Crossings ---
# Each marker = z-score crossed back through zero after an extreme reading
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Mean-Reversion Signal',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Z-Score at Cross',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=2,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='FCX/NEM Ratio',
                type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                dp=3,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Signal',
                type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge,
                card_color_map={"Success": ["Long FCX Reverted"], "Error": ["Short FCX Reverted"]}
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                table_is_filter=True,
                table_visible=False
            )
        ]
    )
)(
    z,
    ratio,
    where(z_cross_up, 'Long FCX Reverted') if z_cross_up else 'Short FCX Reverted',
    is_reversion
)
